programs.description: Radha, a nurse in psychiatric therapy, struggles with emotional detachment. Her role in patients' recovery leads to her own mental breakdown.
A subject-matter expert conducts an informative lecture on songs composed by Rabindranath Tagore with suitable examples in a detailed and easy-to-understand manner.
Kabita, a middle-class working woman, looks after and tries to financially support her family. Soon, she sacrifices the love of her life for her widowed sister.
A poor widow works tirelessly to give her son a good life and education. However, the boy's grandfather, who once refused to accept them, suddenly reappears and offers to adopt him.
Punyo, an Agradani brahmin, is offered land and riches if he lays in front of the room where his wife delivers their baby. When the wife delivers a stillborn baby, Punyo swaps it with his own baby.

Ronnie and Bonnie are swindlers who consistently cheat innocent individuals and compel them for wealth. When the villainous Sashti plunders a shop and slays Bonnie's parent, he falsely implicates Ronnie.
When the employees of an advertising agency start getting killed one after another, detective Prabhat is tasked with finding the person responsible for the murders.
